name: Fluid
tagline: Drag a finger through ink and watch it swirl.
description:
Press and drag. Colour blooms behind the pointer, then folds into itself — a Navier–Stokes toy that already ran on phones. The quality, dye, bloom, and pause settings you pick come back next time, along with a still of the last swirl.

A random-splat button and a screenshot live in the panel. On a phone the panel starts closed; tap the bar. If this GPU cannot keep up, quality steps down and the app says so. If there is no WebGL, it says that too, instead of a black screen.

An unofficial port of WebGL Fluid Simulation by Pavel Dobryakov. Same ink, same pointer.
